## Checklist

- [ ] Spec / plan / tasks updated (`specs/NNN-*`) or not needed for this change
- [ ] ADR added for any significant decision (`docs/adr/`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated at every affected layer (unit, e2e, UI)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (and `npm run openapi:check` for API changes)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, Swagger decorators, `.env.example`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
